title: Decision EE-102: coordinate through typed provenance records routed by the Lead
body:
Adds decision EE-102 to `docs/decisions/decisions.json`: agents coordinate through typed provenance records routed by the Lead (blackboard), with temporary relationship children only for live back-and-forth. Related: EE-029, EE-031. Sources: Brooks; Kim et al. 2025 (arXiv:2512.08296).

Stacked on EE-101 (base is `cursor/jev-llm-code-split-9a9d`); it retargets to main once EE-101 merges.

Built by cloud agent bc-af72ec51 (its PR tool failed with `[unavailable] Error`, so this was opened by Grok Bot at Torian's direction).
